from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List

class CaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information about one judgment document's case classification."""
    document_title: Optional[str] = Field(description="The title/name of this judgment document")
    case_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="The broad category of the case: 刑事, 民事, or 行政")
    cause_of_action: Optional[str] = Field(description="The formal 案由 (cause of action) as stated in the document")
    criminal_charges: List[str] = Field(description="Any criminal charges or 罪名 mentioned in this document; empty list if none")
    document_summary: Optional[str] = Field(description="Brief summary of what this document covers")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: List[CaseInfo]
